title: Sofa Yolo - 1 Seater Sofa (Fabric, Coco Brown)
body_html: Ergonomically designed to fit into any home and for any person, Sofa Yolo is engineered for luxury and comfort. This is a sofa that will leave you feeling blissful. Your living room will never be the same with this contemporary sofa as its centrepiece. With precise lines and tufted cushions, it adds just the right amount of charm and coziness. From its curved, mid-length armrests to sleek tapered legs, this sofa is modern and minimalist without being boring. The Sleepyhead Yolo sofa is made with premium-quality polyester fabric and is resistant to sagging and pilling. This provides a smooth texture for this piece as well as cozy cushioning for plush seating bringing stunning style and outstanding durability to your home. It has Wooden Finish legs and a sturdy frame that make it all the more durable. Sofa YOLO is extra cozy and comfortable owing to the cushioning of the sofa that consists of 3 layers – HR foam, a supersoft layer and outer padding – for an unparalleled and long-lasting level of comfort. The contemporary look screams expensive, and the tufting is buttonless so that it won't poke you in weird places. This adds an extra dash of comfort to the piece. It comes in different options like single-seater, two-seater & three-seater. It also comes in four colour options: Sesame Grey, Berry Blue, Avocado Green and Coco Brown. With its simple yet functional structure, this will blend seamlessly with your decor while providing ample seating space in any room. Sofa Yolo has a relaxed, spacious and contemporary feel and is perfect for family and friends. You can also lounge more selfishly, enjoying all that this sofa has to offer.
